summary: Install Edge Manager on a separate minimal RHEL host (4 cores, 16 GB recommended, root/sudo, Podman) with AAP API URLs and OAuth credentials: podman login registry.redhat.io, enable the ansible-automation-platform-2.5-for-rhel-9-x86_64-rpms repo, dnf install flightctl-services, and set baseDomain in /etc/flightctl/service-config.yaml.
questions: How do I install the Red Hat Edge Manager RPM?
What are the host requirements for Red Hat Edge Manager?

answer_card.title: Install Red Hat Edge Manager services
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
sudo podman login registry.redhat.io
sudo subscription-manager repos --enable ansible-automation-platform-2.5-for-rhel-9-x86_64-rpms
sudo dnf install -y flightctl-services
sudo vi /etc/flightctl/service-config.yaml   # set baseDomain
sudo systemctl enable flightctl.target
sudo systemctl start flightctl.target
sudo systemctl list-units flightctl-*.service
```
Use a separate minimal RHEL host (4 cores, 16 GB RAM recommended).
